name: EmuDeck (Linux / SteamOS)
notes: The emulation path is a setting: roms and bios stay siblings under it.
ES-DE matches the extension as written (esde es-app/src/SystemData.cpp:666): its lists carry both cases, kept here lowercased.
A system folder holding noload.txt is not loaded (esde es-app/src/SystemData.cpp:629-631).
Default emulator: the alternativeEmulator label written for the system, else the first <command>.
Some alternative emulators are set only when the standalone is installed (os functions/ToolScripts/emuDeckESDE.sh:316-318).

esde.note: EmuDeck installs the newest ES-DE release at run time. The list is read at this tag
